description: This file contains automated tests for poll-related functions such as parsing poll start content, building poll response content, and summarizing poll results. It uses the Vitest testing framework to verify behavior and correctness of the poll handling logic.

methods.name: parsePollStartContent
methods.description: Parses the legacy and current format of poll start content and extracts the question, answers, and max selections.

methods.name: parsePollStart
methods.description: Parses the poll start event, preserving answer ids and constraining max selections based on available answers.

methods.name: buildPollStartContent
methods.description: Builds the poll start event content, preserving multiselect settings.

methods.name: buildPollResponseContent
methods.description: Constructs a poll response payload referencing a poll event.

methods.name: parsePollResponseAnswerIds
methods.description: Extracts answer ids from poll response events, handling both stable and unstable reply formats.

methods.name: resolvePollReferenceEventId
methods.description: Resolves the event id of a poll reference from the relationship event.

methods.name: buildPollResultsSummary
methods.description: Aggregates poll responses to generate a summary counting only the latest response from each sender.

methods.name: formatPollResultsAsText
methods.description: Formats the poll results summary as a human-readable text string, including vote counts.
